title: The Century Dictionary and Cyclopedia
author: William Dwight Whitney (editor-in-chief)
edition: First edition printing, c. 1895, in ten volumes (New York: The Century Co., copyright 1889); volumes 9-10 are The Century Cyclopedia of Names
words_note: 18,199,316 is the cleaned-text total for the audit-restored run (same method as the pre-audit 18,212,236: words across all entries.json records, dictionary + front/back matter). Entry text totals 18143744 words; the remainder is front matter, back matter, running heads and text the parser never assigned to an entry.
letters_note: The book has real J (1,374 entries) and U (5,026 entries) sections, so j.json and u.json exist. Entries are filed by the first letter of the lookup key; the site looks an entry up by fetching the file named after the first letter of its key.
corrections_note: 745,414 by the audit re-run (Nov 2026), down from 837,129 pre-audit: hyphen-join 268,649; engine-1edit 142,714; engine-freq 142,532; scan2 95,728; engine-cached 75,126; context-blanket 12,104; context-fragjoin 5,866; audit-restore 1,028; context-aux-be 640; context-tailjoin 522; audit-decision 211; pattern-v-mark 178; context-withinline 87; context-prefix 29. Second scans were usable for vols. 1-7; none for vols. 8 and 10; the vol. 9 Toronto scan was rejected (agreement 0.2315).
audit_note: No-omission audit, 2026-11-27: the cleanup had wrongly changed genuine printed text, and the audit re-run restored it as printed — Shakespeare citations (Shak., not Hak.), archaic spellings (haue, thei, tyme, euery, vpon), hyphenated compounds (so-called, well-known, to-day), Roman numerals (xxxiv., not xxiv.), and the obsolete-mark dagger (II.†, I.†). No disagreement case was found in this book: nothing was changed because the corrector disagreed with the writer. Dictionary entries fell 192,980 to 192,925 (55 fewer) because re-joined text merged a few entry boundaries, mostly in vol. 10; no article text was deleted. See reference/century-dictionary-c1895/audit-restorations.md.
citation: The Century Dictionary is paginated. Cite entries by volume and printed page (e.g. vol. 6, p. 4623). Page numbers are interpolated where the scan's page number was not read.
back_matter_note: One back-matter record per volume. Volumes 1-9 have no back matter, so those nine records are empty by design and are kept as-is; only volume 10 has back matter (the Atlas table of contents, text only — the maps are images).
population_key_note: The key 'population' holds 673 entries: 1 genuine dictionary entry (vol. 6, p. 4623) plus 672 Cyclopedia of Names entries (411 in vol. 9, 261 in vol. 10) whose parsed headword is 'Population' — the parser took the 'Population (1890), ...' line that opens each place entry for the headword. The text is the real book text, kept verbatim; the headword string is as parsed, not corrected. The vol. 10 count rose 232 to 261 in the audit re-run as re-joined place-entry text re-split at the Population line.
entry_count_note: 192,925 parsed entries is a lower bound. The parser does not split cross-references, suffix/prefix entries, entries whose headwords the OCR destroyed (superscript-numbered homographs), no-POS proper-name entries (many in the Cyclopedia of Names), entries starting mid-line where the djvu text interleaves the two columns, or phrase sub-entries (kept inside the parent entry). No entry was invented; missed entries' text is still present in the cleaned file in reading order.
source: HathiTrust 007695796 (Internet Archive text for all ten volumes). Title pages verified from the printed images. The 1897 printing was identified and rejected; vol. 8's first candidate proved to be 1897 and was replaced by centurydictionar0008will (1895).
